crossRefs.note: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

parallels.note: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.

people.name: Beriah
people.line: Son of Asher and head of a clan

people.name: Heber
people.line: Son of Beriah, grandson of Asher.

people.name: Malchiel
people.line: Son of Beriah, grandson of Asher.

translations.web: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
translations.bsb: And these were the descendants of Beriah: the Heberite clan from Heber and the Malchielite clan from Malchiel.
translations.kjv: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
translations.asv: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
